deadline.value: International applicants for September 2027 apply by March 1, 2027; supporting documents and references are due within 15 days after the deadline. Year inferred.
deadline.quote: For admission on September 1: | International students - apply by March 1 | Please note that supporting documents and references are due within 15 days after the application deadline.

gre_subject.value: No test scores are required, so the Chemistry GRE is not needed.

gre_general.value: The program lists no required test scores, so the GRE is not needed.

supervisor.value: You must contact faculty and list potential supervisors when you apply; the department admits no one without a willing supervisor.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor is required at time of application; potential supervisors must be listed when applying to the program

also.quote: Applicants must contact faculty members directly regarding supervision of their graduate program, prior to submitting an application. The Department does not accept students unless at least one faculty member has indicated a willingness to act as supervisor.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student is guaranteed at least CAD 33,205 a year (international; CAD 31,426 domestic) for the first four years, if progress stays satisfactory.
funding.quote: Full-time PhD students beginning their program on or after January 1, 2026, are guaranteed a minimum funding package of $31,426 for domestic students and $33,205 for international students. | These annual amounts are guaranteed for the first four years of a PhD program

entry_route.value: An MSc is required; a four-year honours bachelor's with a 3.70 GPA is also considered.
entry_route.quote: MSc required. A four-year honours bachelor degree with a minimum 3.70 GPA will also be considered.

toefl_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need TOEFL iBT 97 with 23 in each section (5.0 with 5.0 in each section on the new scale for tests on or after January 21, 2026).
toefl_min.quote: Graduate programs in the Faculty of Science require higher minimum scores than those specified by the Faculty of Graduate Studies. | TOEFL iBT (tests taken before January 21, 2026): 97 (minimum 23 in each section) | TOEFL iBT (tests taken on or after January 21, 2026): 5.0 (minimum 5.0 in each section)

ielts_min.value: Faculty of Science programs need IELTS Academic 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each section.
